workspaceId.description: Workspace that will own the integration.

providerId.description: ID of the provider (exchange/blockchain/wallet) to connect. Required unless isCustomWallet is true — custom wallets are attached to a sentinel provider automatically.

alias.description: Unique, human-friendly name for this integration within the workspace (optional).

credentialKind.description: Authentication method used to connect — determines the shape of `credentialData`. api_key: key/secret pair; address: read-only on-chain address; account_name: username (+ optional password); csv: CSV-file import; none: no credentials.

credentialData.description: Credential payload — shape MUST match `credentialKind`. Omit (or `{}`) for csv/none.

passphrase.description: The passphrase field for providers that need one (OKX, KuCoin, Bitget, OKCoin, Coinbase Pro/Prime, Poloniex Futures).

password.description: Legacy alias for `passphrase` — accepted for backwards compatibility with older clients, normalized into `passphrase` server-side.

address.description: IDEX only: the wallet address credential field.

privateKey.description: IDEX only: the wallet's private key (hex), required alongside apiKey/secret/address.

privateKeyPem.description: Fireblocks-only: RSA private key (PEM), used instead of secretKey.

oneOf.description: Credential shape for credentialKind `address` (read-only on-chain address).
oneOf.title: AddressCredential

oneOf.description: Empty object for csv / none kinds

userFunctions.description: User-selected provider functions to run. Omit to run all enabled functions.

startTime.description: Default sync start time (Unix ms, positive). Overrides incremental sync.

endTime.description: Default sync end time (Unix ms, positive). Caps every sync window for this account, resync_from_start included. Must not be before startTime.

timezone.description: IANA timezone used for CSV date parsing.

isCustomWallet.description: Mark this as a user-defined custom (manual) wallet integration.

skipInitialSync.description: When true, do not auto-trigger a sync on creation (API integrations only).
